fusions.name: Silverleaf Shoal
fusions.desc: Sheds 3 slick willow leaves that swim out in a loose shoal, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Under the Bank
fusions.desc: Bank roots close on a target at or below 25% of its health and drag it under, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Riverworn Rind
fusions.desc: Your bark runs slick with river water: your armour rises by 15% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip and Settle
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and harden into a bark shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, the stacks fade.
